summary: A Mandarin tutorial that demonstrates four ways to make PPT slides with Google AI tools: a NotebookLM one-click deck, Gemini Canvas, Google Slides 'Beautify this slide', and an outline-then-Canvas workflow in Gemini, followed by tips on making good presentations.

questions.question: In the Gemini Canvas demo, which is then exported to Google Slides, what English title is shown on the generated deck's title slide?
In the fourth workflow (outline first, then Canvas), the generated slide '5. The Cost of Intelligence' highlights one large dollar figure. What is it?
When the speaker types his Canvas prompt for the 'ten major AI events' talk and skips the requirements with 'blah blah blah', what visual colour style does the on-screen prompt actually ask for?
questions.answer: Cool tones (冷色调), in a young and lively style

questions.question: According to the speaker, what kind of file does NotebookLM's one-click presentation feature actually produce, and why can't its text be edited?
questions.answer: An image-based PDF, because it is generated by the Nano Banana image model
